svg.title: Tejal Goyal
svg.desc: Tejal Goyal (@tejalgoyal2). Software engineer. I build AI agents, data pipelines, and things that are fun to use. Latest push: portfolio: the files for machines are shorter and carry no email address: llms.txt is six highlights, the work and the links, and llms-full.txt has the rest; and tgoyal.me/github is a short link that shows a proper preview picture and then sends people to my GitHub.
